description: Get a single Dutch cadastral parcel by its feature id (from search_percelen results). Returns municipality, section, parcel number, registered size (m²), validity status, and boundary geometry. Data: PDOK / Kadaster (api.pdok.nl), open data, no auth required.

id.description: Feature id (UUID) of a cadastral parcel, e.g. from netherlands-pdok-kadaster.search_percelen results

name: netherlands-pdok-kadaster.cadastre.get_perceel

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Dutch Cadastral Parcel Detail
